_provenance: Redacted from a live Entra tenant on 2026-08-21 via Microsoft Graph v1.0: GET /applications?$filter=appId eq '<client-id>'&$select=id,appId,displayName,keyCredentials. All GUIDs and display names here are synthetic. The one detail that is capture-verified and load-bearing is the customKeyIdentifier ENCODING: this tenant returns the SHA-1 thumbprint as a 40-character UPPERCASE HEX string, NOT the base64 the Graph docs describe. The list-keys report must treat that hex as authoritative or it mislabels the live certificate an orphan and invites its deletion.
